earnings.title: November 17, 2026
highlights: Revenues increased 16% for the fourth quarter to $25.9 billion from $22.5 billion in Q4 fiscal 2025.
Total segment operating income (2) increased 43% to $5.0 billion from $3.5 billion in Q4 fiscal 2025.
Diluted earnings per share (EPS) increased to $1.51 from $0.73 in Q4 fiscal 2025.
Adjusted EPS increased to $1.77 from $1.11 in Q4 fiscal 2025.
Revenues increased 8% for the fiscal year to $102.3 billion from $94.4 billion in fiscal 2025.
outlook: Notably, adjusted EPS growth excluding the 53 rd week exceeded our prior guidance of approximately 12%.
We now expect the program to realize annual run-rate operating expense savings of approximately $3 billion by fiscal 2029.
Total Segment Operating Income: We expect total segment operating income growth of approximately 8%, excluding the impact of the 53 rd week and giving effect to the reporting changes.
Capital Expenditures: We expect capital expenditures of approximately $9 billion as we continue to execute against our strategy to turbocharge growth at Disney Experiences.

items.heading: Declines in U.S., global and regional economic conditions adversely affect our results of operations and financial condition.
items.group: RISKS RELATED TO OUR BUSINESSES AND INDUSTRY

items.heading: Fluctuations in foreign currency exchange rates impact our results of operations, including our revenues and costs.

Changes in technology, in consumer consumption patterns and in how entertainment products and services are created affect demand for, the revenue we can generate from and the cost of producing or distributing our entertainment offerings and our results of operations.

We face risks relating to misalignment with public and consumer tastes and preferences for entertainment, travel and consumer products, which impacts demand for our entertainment offerings and products and services and our results of operations.

A variety of uncontrollable events disrupt our businesses, reduce demand for or consumption of our products and services, impair our ability to provide our products and services or increase the cost of providing our products and services, adversely impacting our results of operations and financial condition.
We face risks related to changes in our business strategies and plans, which have affected and may continue to affect our cost structure, the value of our assets and/or our results of operations.
